name: You Are Not Callum
source:
Callum's father is suddenly interested in his son's love affairs after several years of avoiding the topic. Follow Callum's life and reflect on what kind of person you want to be.

[From [url=https://fdrstar.itch.io/you-are-not-callum]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡勒姆的父亲在回避这个话题几年后突然对儿子的恋情感兴趣。关注卡勒姆的生活，反思你想成为什么样的人。

[来自[url=https://fdrstar.itch.io/you-are-not-callum]Itch.io[/url]]
